decisions_made_before_any_replay.half_days_2024_03_02_and_2024_05_18: They stay, as the frozen export defines sessions. Futures exist only 09:15-09:59 and 11:30-12:30, so the replay has no observation in the break or after 12:30: nothing is manufactured and nothing trades there. A leg still open at the last observation is stored UNRESOLVED with no rupee result. Every trade on these two days is listed in the results, with the verdict re-stated without them if it would differ. The frozen procedure is not changed.
decisions_made_before_any_replay.saturday_2024_01_20: A full regular session (NSE MSD60340); kept.
decisions_made_before_any_replay.muhurat_2024_11_01: Excluded by the frozen mirror rule; no future or option rows exist for it.
decisions_made_before_any_replay.banknifty_daily_2024_04_19: Open and low are invalid in the source, confirmed on re-fetch. Preserved, not filled. No scored book reads NIFTY BANK: replays read only yeardata.regime (logged live labels, else UNKNOWN), and features.daily_bars reads NIFTY only. It enters only rebuild_regimes, a manifest description that the exam never reads, and that reads only the close, which is valid.
decisions_made_before_any_replay.stray_bars: Futures bars at 09:14 (Jan 9, Jan 11) are outside the frozen export window and dropped. Bars at 15:31-15:32 (Aug 26, Oct 22) stay, as the frozen export window keeps them; they fall after the last entry and exit times.
decisions_made_before_any_replay.lot_size: 65, as frozen, so a per-lot row is today's contract; the real 2024 lot was different.
decisions_made_before_any_replay.expiry_days: No same-day options exist on the 52 expiry sessions, by design and as in 2025 (53) and 2026 (43): the live single-leg book makes no entries then, so the downloads skip them (DOWNLOAD_GUIDE). 196 sessions can take an entry.
